refBuckets with times.query:
WITH toUnixTimestamp64Nano(utc) AS x
       SELECT toString(x - positiveModulo(x, {w:Int64})) AS b, count(), toString(min(x)), toString(max(x))
       FROM sdlog.conf_signals WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND utc IS NOT NULL
       GROUP BY b

refBuckets counts.query:

       FROM sdlog.conf_signals WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND utc IS NOT NULL

refCount.query: SELECT count() FROM sdlog.conf_signals WHERE vehicle = {ref:String}

loggerGaps.query:
SELECT toString(prev_hi), toString(lo), toString(last), rn FROM (
         SELECT lo, lagInFrame(hi) OVER w AS prev_hi, row_number() OVER w AS rn, max(hi) OVER () AS last
         FROM (
           SELECT x - positiveModulo(x, {g:Int64}) AS b, min(x) AS lo, max(x) AS hi
           FROM (SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Nano(utc) AS x FROM sdlog.conf_signals
                 WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND utc IS NOT NULL)
           GROUP BY b)
         WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY b ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
       WHERE rn = 1 OR lo - prev_hi >= {min:Int64}
       ORDER BY lo

stateChanges by labels.query:
SELECT toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(t_)), v_, x_,
              if(rn = 1, '', toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(pt))), pv, ptext
       FROM (
         SELECT utc AS t_, value AS v_, '' AS x_,
                lagInFrame(t_) OVER w AS pt, lagInFrame(v_) OVER w AS pv,
                lagInFrame(x_) OVER w AS ptext, row_number() OVER w AS rn
         FROM sdlog.conf_signals
         WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND signal = {sig:String} AND utc IS NOT NULL AND NOT arrayExists((lo, hi) -> value >= lo AND value <= hi,
                         {snaLo:Array(Float64)}, {snaHi:Array(Float64)})
         WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY t_ ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
       )
       WHERE rn = 1 OR abs(v_ - pv) > {tol:Float64} AND (arrayExists(l -> abs(v_ - l) <= {tol:Float64}, {labels:Array(Float64)})
             OR arrayExists(l -> abs(pv - l) <= {tol:Float64}, {labels:Array(Float64)}))
       ORDER BY t_ LIMIT {limit:UInt32}

stateChanges by text.query:
SELECT toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(t_)), v_, x_,
              if(rn = 1, '', toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(pt))), pv, ptext
       FROM (
         SELECT utc AS t_, value AS v_, text AS x_,
                lagInFrame(t_) OVER w AS pt, lagInFrame(v_) OVER w AS pv,
                lagInFrame(x_) OVER w AS ptext, row_number() OVER w AS rn
         FROM sdlog.conf_signals
         WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND signal = {sig:String} AND utc IS NOT NULL AND NOT 0
         WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY t_ ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
       )
       WHERE rn = 1 OR x_ != ptext
       ORDER BY t_ LIMIT {limit:UInt32}

events.query:
SELECT toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(utc)), source, kind, name, value,
                text, detail
         FROM sdlog.conf_events WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND utc IS NOT NULL
         ORDER BY utc, kind, source, name LIMIT {limit:UInt32}

firstTimes.query:
SELECT signal, groupArray(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(utc))) FROM (
         SELECT signal, utc FROM sdlog.conf_signals
         WHERE vehicle = {ref:String} AND signal IN {names:Array(String)} AND utc IS NOT NULL
         ORDER BY signal, utc LIMIT {rows:UInt32} BY signal)
       GROUP BY signal
